## IT S R      R   ND ISSUER PURCHASES OF EQUITY SECURITIES

Our common stock is listed on the New York Stock Exchange ("NYSE") and the Berlin Stock Exchange and is traded under the symbol CTL and CYT, respectively.

At February 21, 2020, there were approximately 93,000 stockholders of record, although there were significantly more beneficial holders of our common stock.
